title: Infinitely scale 1-1 customer calls
cardDesc: AI video replica that can have real-time conversations with customers. Scale myself infinitely
paragraphs: Not sure where to start with AI agents? Start an instant zoom call with a digital version of me! It'll gather your requirements and help you automate.
Tons of people have been asking how I use AI agents to automate mundane tasks. Everyone's situation is different. I'd love to help everyone, but I can't do 10 calls every day.
So I hacked up a replica of myself you can actually talk to. Like a zoom call. It talks like me. Asks follow-up questions. Figures out what you actually need.
Built with Tavus. I've seen AI clones before, but never ones this natural in real-time. The latency is insanely good.
If you're drowning in the same call patterns and wish you could scale your 1-1 time with customers, this might be it :)
